meta.status: ck3.*, fate, levels and parameters are VERIFIED copies of the install. bl.* effects are INFERRED design (CONVERSION, PERSONAL, SIDE_EXTRA in the generator).
meta.trackSemantics: Track steps are cumulative: at XP x a character has the base modifiers plus every step with xp <= x (INFERRED from the data: lifestyle_blademaster negate_health_penalty_add 0.25+0.25+0.5 = 1.0 exactly; the_wake wetlands_advantage +2/+3/+1 would otherwise fall at higher levels; gallowsbait, charioteer_* and clouded_eyes repeat identical steps that would be pointless otherwise). To confirm in game: a level-3 forest_fighter shows +8 Forest Advantage and +3 Advantage in the trait tooltip.
meta.prowessAndMartial: prowess*/martial* values are part of CK3's final prowess and martial, which the snapshot already carries (C record ck3xbl_c_prowess / ck3xbl_c_martial). They are listed in ck3 for completeness and never re-applied (alreadyCounted).
meta.commanderOnly: CK3 applies advantage, combat-roll, casualty and retreat modifiers only for the combat side's commander (loc icon command_modifier_i). Knights get nothing from them. Characters with disables_combat_leadership (incapable, infirm, wounded_1..3) never command.

conversion.status: INFERRED (design constants; calibrate in play tests). The CK3 inputs are VERIFIED.

advantage.rule: adv(side) = commander martial + sum of side.advantage effects of the side commander whose `when` holds + terrain defender_advantage (defender only, scaled by the attacker commander's side.enemyDefenderTerrainAdvantageAdd: max(0, 1 + sum)) + 5 for the defender in harsh winter; delta = adv(att) - adv(def). The side ahead: every agent deals damage x (1 + perPoint * |delta|), capped at maxDamageBonus, and starts with initial morale + min(maxMoraleBonus, |delta|). Same rule as mapping.json commander_rules.advantage; this table only adds the trait terms.
advantage.ck3Reference: CK3 game rule advantage_damage_effect default 5% damage per advantage point (common/game_rules/00_game_rules.txt:1570-1579); halved for Bannerlord because its melee already snowballs.

combatRoll.rule: CK3 rolls a commander roll in [COMMANDER_MIN_ROLL + min_combat_roll, COMMANDER_MAX_ROLL + max_combat_roll] every COMBAT_ROLL_DAYS (0..10 every 3 days, common/defines/00_defines.txt:584,602-603) and adds it to the advantage. A min/max change d shifts the expected roll by d/2 (-> side.advantage d/2) and the spread by +d (max) / -d (min) (-> side.rollSpread). The spread becomes volatility: every agent of the side deals AND takes damage x clamp(1 + perSpreadPoint * sum(rollSpread), 1 - maxVolatility, 1 + maxVolatility).

conversion.enemyTerrainAdvantage: side.enemyDefenderTerrainAdvantageAdd v (CK3 enemy_terrain_advantage, loc "Counters enemy defensive terrain advantage"): the ENEMY side's terrain defender_advantage is multiplied by max(0, 1 + sum(v)) before the delta is formed. Only matters when the holder's side attacks.
conversion.casualties: outcome.* effects change the bridge's CK3 write-back (bridge/CK3xBL.Mapping/Resolution/CasualtyModel): own fatal share x max(0, 1 + sum(outcome.ownFatalShareAdd)); the enemy side's fatal share x max(0, 1 + sum(outcome.enemyFatalShareAdd)); own pursuit (retreat) losses x max(0, 1 + sum(outcome.ownRetreatLossAdd)), on top of the terrain retreat_losses already applied. Presentation in Bannerlord: the enemy side's troopDeathChance (killed vs knocked out) is multiplied by the same enemy factor.

faithHostility.rule: side.advantage effects with when.faithHostility are scaled by the enemy side commander's faith hostility level towards the holder's faith (CK3 faith_hostility_level, triggers.log:10110): 0 righteous, 1 astray, 2 hostile, 3 evil.

tactics.rule: side.tacticsAdd is added to the Tactics skill of the side's general hero in request.json (heroes[].skills.Tactics, max 300) on top of clamp(10 * martial, 0, 300). In a custom battle Tactics only matters at the gates of MissionCombatantsLogic.EarlyStart (<20 Charge only; >=20 FullScaleAttack + DefensiveEngagement/DefensiveLine or RangedHarrassmentOffensive; >=50 FrontalCavalryCharge + DefensiveRing/HoldChokePoint or CoordinatedRetreat), taken as the max Tactics over the side's characters.

ownerTroops.rule: group.* effects come from the army OWNER's modifiers (CK3 computes a regiment's stats with its owner's character modifiers) and apply to the agents of that owner's groups (levy#<army>, maa:<key>#<army>#<regiment>) whose MaA base type matches when.maaBaseType (or MaA key when.maaType; `all` = every MaA group; levy effects only the levy group). damage_mult m -> damage dealt x (1 + damageShare * m); toughness_mult m -> damage taken x 1 / (1 + toughnessShare * m); *_add values are made relative to the regiment's CK3 base stat (ck3_catalog.json maa_types[].damage/toughness, levy 10) first. pursuit/screen go to the bridge's pursuit model (outcome) unchanged.

conversion.stacking: Within one character: effects of the same name and same `when` add (side.*, outcome.*, *Add) or multiply (*Mult); booleans OR. Across characters: side.* and outcome.* come from the side commander only; hero.* from that hero only; retinue.* from the knight only; group.* from the army owner; liege.* from the knights' liege.

side.advantage.hook: bridge: advantage delta (CONVERSION.advantage) -> side.damageDealtMult + side.initialMoraleAdd in request.<side>.buffs

side.enemyDefenderTerrainAdvantageAdd.hook: bridge: scales the enemy's terrain defender_advantage in the delta

side.chargeDamageMult.hook: module: CK3AgentApplyDamageModel.ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers when collisionData.IsHorseCharge or the attacker rides and strikes in melee

outcome.ownFatalShareAdd.hook: bridge: CasualtyModel fatal share of the holder's side

outcome.enemyFatalShareAdd.hook: bridge: CasualtyModel fatal share of the enemy side; module: enemy side troopDeathChance (presentation)

outcome.ownRetreatLossAdd.hook: bridge: CasualtyModel pursuit losses of the holder's side

outcome.pursuitAdd.hook: bridge: pursuit of the owner's matching regiments

outcome.screenAdd.hook: bridge: screen of the owner's matching regiments

group.damageDealtMult.hook: module: ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers, attacker agent (rider for a mount) in a matching group

group.damageTakenMult.hook: module: ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers, victim agent in a matching group

group.ck3DamageAdd.hook: bridge: -> group.damageDealtMult via the regiment's CK3 base damage (CONVERSION.ownerTroops)

group.ck3ToughnessAdd.hook: bridge: -> group.damageTakenMult via the regiment's CK3 base toughness

liege.knightEffectivenessAdd.hook: bridge: knight effectiveness (ck3_knight_effectiveness_sources.json) -> knight health x damage multiplier

liege.knightEffectivenessPerSkillPoint.hook: bridge: x the liege's skill named in when.per

hero.damageDealtMult.hook: module: ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers, attacker = hero (or his mount); when.weapon melee|ranged, when.vs hero

hero.chargeDamageMult.hook: module: ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers, horse charge or mounted melee by the hero

hero.startHealthFraction.hook: module: MissionLogic.OnAgentBuild, Health = max(1, HealthLimit x fraction) after the healthMultiplier

hero.knockdownResistanceAdd.hook: module: GetKnockDownResistance, GetKnockBackResistance (and half to GetDismountResistance)

hero.skillAdd.hook: module: CK3AgentStatCalculateModel.GetEffectiveSkill (when.skill); flows into weapon damage, speed and AI level

hero.deathChanceMult.hook: bridge: heroes[].deathChance = 0.3 x mult (cap 0.9; presentation of killed vs knocked out). CK3 fates use `fate` below

retinue.initialMoraleAdd.hook: module: OnAgentBuild, SetMorale(GetMorale() + v) for agents of group knight-retinue#<tag>

emitPlan.status: PROPOSED additions to the CK3 mod (PROTOCOL §5.5 style CX lines; unknown CX fields are already ignored by the bridge, BattleSnapshotBuilder.CharacterFact). Not implemented: the main build owns ck3_mod/ and tools/gen/gen_ck3_mod.mjs.

records.CX|ktrait|<key>: one line per held trait of `traitsNotEmittedToday` (same if-chain shape as CX|ctrait)
records.CX|txp|<key>[:<track>]|<level>: trait level 1..n (first matching has_trait_xp of the chain, highest first); no line = level 0. Only for `traitsWithLevels` the character holds
records.S dump ck3xbl_s_has_cmd / ck3xbl_s_cmd: side_commander of the combat side (event_targets.log:1596) so the bridge knows whose side.* effects apply; the side commander is also listed as C|CMD
records.S dump ck3xbl_s_hostility: optional: faith_hostility_level of the ENEMY side commander's faith towards this side commander's faith (0..3), for when.faithHostility (holy_warrior, crusader_king)

bl.why: Deadlier assaults (CK3 enemy_hard_casualty_modifier); unlocks the Lancer accolade attribute.
Blademaster levels (prowess +3/+6/+12 already counted): quicker blade work, every weapon skill +20 per level.
